mentions.name: TheLastSaaS
mentions.description: Open source (MIT) data and backend layer that serves as glue between AI assistants, agents, and data. Provides a flexible data layer plus users, groups, granular permissions, notifications, durable work queues, and audit logs, with MCP and CLI interfaces that work across agents and assistants such as Claude and GPT.
mentions.problem: Small teams and agencies need to build one-off solutions for collaboration and operations inside the tools they already use.
mentions.audience: Small teams and agencies that need to build one-off solutions for collaboration and operations inside the harness they already use.
mentions.source_excerpt:
The glue between AI assistants, agents, and data. 100% open source (MIT).

Provides a flexible data layer plus users, groups, granular permissions, notifications, durable work queues, audit logs and more… MCP and CLI interfaces. Works across all agents and assistants (Claude, GPT, etc)
mentions.author: mkly
